newsitem.title: GREECE: Albanian pirates raid Britons' yacht off Corfu.
newsitem.headline: Albanian pirates raid Britons' yacht off Corfu.

text.p: Albanian pirates in a speedboat boarded and robbed the yacht of two British tourists in the narrow strait between Albania and Corfu, the Greek Ministry of Merchant Marine reported on Wednesday.
"The four armed men held the two Britons at gun point, stole their personal belongings and equipment and set off towards the Albanian coast," the ministry said in a statement.

The Britons, Ian Robert Baxter and Sally Forrester, told port authorities in the Greek holiday island of Corfu that the gunmen took about 15 minutes to raid their Greek-registered yacht, the Saggitarius, on Tuesday afternoon.

The ministry said the same Albanian gunmen had earlier tried to approach another British yacht, the Echythump, with two British tourists on board, but failed and sped away. Both yachts were in Albanian waters during the incidents, it said.

Gunmen have raided a number of yachts docked at Corfu's marinas this year and Greece has sent special commandos to the popular Ionian Sea island to protect them. Corfu is less than two miles from Albania's coast.
